dataset.description:
Types of data generated:
• Sample metadata: sex, family origin, phenotypic traits.
• Raw long-read sequencing data (PacBio) from targeted capture of sdY loci.
• Assembled contigs of sdY loci (per individual).
• Annotated sequence variants (SNPs, indels, structural variants).
• Analysis outputs: alignments, coverage statistics, structural variation reports, molecular sex marker candidates.
dataset.title: AQUASERV | Molecular Biology & Omics | sequencing

dmp.description: This project will investigate the genetic mechanism of sex determination in European whitefish. It will use biological samples from males and females European whitefish (Coregonus lavaretus) to sequence their putative sex determining loci (named sdY) to infer how these loci correlate with the phenotypic sex of the sequenced individuals. This DMP describes the management of biological, genomic and phenotypic data generated in the  project.  It will ensures compliance with FAIR principles, ethical standards, and AquaServ open data policies.
